content: Macawtaco Khazing dopaw sawtei naa cang cawtah Khazing a ziaza khah a lah my lo.
Khri tah ma do katei kaa cawtah a hringnah khah ringthopaw pehlainah le athuihlainah tah Khazing kha a pehpaw hratah donah hringzia khei hring my lo.

Canghrasala, naa hrong letah canu capaw suanah le a pialuipaw a cangpaw maikaw le duhlui dunah tahpaw sahlo cawh a thlang tahmai alai ruapaw cang be. Zecawtamaw tatah ma sahlo cawh Khazing a mehpathai sahlo khaco a tlah be.
Biapia bialui, a huaha lypaw bia le siasing palui biarei zong naaning kha a tlah be. Ma navy co Khazing khatah lawngbia rei hri my lo.

Mataico ma heh hnih my lo. Canu capaw suanah le a pialuipaw le duhlui a dupaw cawngsaw (Ma hapaw cawngsaw cawh nono a behpaw a cang) taco Khazing le Khri painah raang letah ry cy ruapaw zehmai hnui be.
A longpaw bia tah ahohmai a dungkheisah khe lo, ma hapaw hming rawng tahei rei a nge lypaw ma cawngsaw sahlo cung leco Khazing thingaenah cawh a tlung hi.
Macawtaco aaning sahlo khaco a pahlawh khe lo.
Khuahlai taco muinah letah ung he ceh ka, canghrasala atoheh cawh Abuipaw letah khainah letah na ung myca he ceh. Macawtaco khainah letei a ungpaw sahlo hratah hring hri my lo.
Khainah a thuisu cawh chahnah vytei, dingnah vytei le biahmuisui vytei a cang he.
Abuipaw lung a tongpaw hming tukhah hni a pachia my lo.
Muinah letei a tlawnglaipaw cawngsaw sahlo tei, aa tuapaw thui le su a hnui lypaw lekhei a pahlawh hrah khe la, chahlynah aa tuapaw tukhah hnisah kaw hri my lo.
Bia a nge lypaw sahlo tei aparuh teitah aa tuapaw hming sahlo kong reilai hmai heh ningzaw a chuipaw a cang.
Canghrasala khainah tei a palangpaw maikaw cawh hmuh thlu a cang a,
zecawtamaw tatah zezong vytei hmuh khypaw tei a tuapaw cawh khainah heh a cang. Macawtaco ma hrahei reipaw a cang,

content.text: “Vy a ihningpaw, a hrah myca la,
Khri tah na cung letah a ca khaiso a,”

content: tahpaw heh.
Macawtaco naa hringzia lekhei a raering ngetei tua o, mehruh hratah ung khe la, mehsing hratah ung my lo,
caichaw naa hmuhpaw maikaw khah achaw teitah hmang a zawng my lo, zecawtamaw tatah atotei kaa cai heh caichia a cang hi.
Macawtaco hruh khe la, Abuipaw dunah zemaw a cang tahpaw tukhah hni a zong hri my lo.
Hringzia a rawhrang khypaw zu khah rui khe la, Thlawpaw tu tah chih hri my lo.
Reithainah hlaw le Khazing hlaw le Thlawpaw hlaw tahpaw sahlo khei pakheh le pakheh thawzaang a pei la, naa lungthing vytei khei Abuipaw reithainah hlaw khah sah my lo.
Kaa Buipaw Zisu Khri a ming tah zezong vytei letah Paw Khazing khaco alawngnah bia hlai paria thlang my lo.
Khri aa cizawpaw naa cang cawtah pakheh le pakheh naa rai a daw my lo.
Nupui le pasae
Naaning nupui sahlo, Abuipaw a rai na dawpaw hra he ceh tah, naa pasae leh aa rai a daw my lo.
Zecawtamaw tatah Khri cawh Ama a pung a cangpaw khrisawbu lu a cangpaw hratah pasae cawh a nupui lu a cang. Khri cawh khrisawbu a Pachahtu a cang.
Macawtaco khrisawbu tah Khri rai a dawpaw hratah nupui sahlo taco pasae leh khah zezongpui letah aa rai a daw hrah he seh.
Naaning pasae sahlo, Khri tah khrisawbu do katei, a cawtah a hringnah a pehpaw hrakhei naa nupui leh khah do my lo.
Khrisawbu cawh pathai sá pawtah bia khah hmang tah tui tah a pathaisah.
Ma hratei a tuapaw cawh reipachianah le suisepaw a unglypaw le a pathaipaw, ange cangpaw khrisawbu khah Ama lilaw khatah peh a du cawtah a cang.
Ma hraco pasae leh taco aaning aa pung aa dopaw hratah aa nupui leh khah aa do ruapaw he a cang. A nupui a dopaw cawh ama le ama a dopaw a cang.
Zecawtamaw tatah ahotahmai a pung cawh a hua bang be, Khri tah khrisawbu mingkai katei, a congpaw hratah mingkai ka, a cong hri.
Kaaning cawh ama a pung letei a caibai sahlo khah ka cang he peh.
“Capaw tah a no le a paw khah seisai he ka, a nupui khah a hlawng a, taico aa pahning co ngaisaw pungkheh tah aa cang a,” a tahpaw khah ma rawng tahei a cang.
Ma heh a thuhpaw biaparuh cang ka, canghrasala kama taco Khri le khrisawbu kong ka rei.
Ma duitei cawh naaning vytei tah naa pung naa dopaw hratah naa nupui leh zong naa do hrahringpaw he a cang. Nupui taco, a pasae khah a cizaw hrahringpaw a cang.
